svg.title: Flow 3: Codex request, human review, explicit resume
svg.desc: tracepermit_request_simulated_change: sg-demo, port, documentation CIDR. After token, enrollment, scope and policy checks, store pending plus exact snapshot. Return approvalRequestId, requestHash, pending and not_executed. Sign in separately, review exact arguments and submit hash-bound decision with CSRF. Verify distinct current human reviewer and atomically record approve or deny. Approved is still not_executed, there is no automatic dispatch. tracepermit_resume_approval: original ID plus requestHash, no replacement arguments. Recheck owner, client, origin, reviewer, policy, expiry and immutable action. Verify permit, atomically consume approval and claim execution. Invoke the approved simulator action only after the claim commits. Commit the confirmed completion separately. Return consumed / succeeded, replay cannot dispatch again. Self-review, wrong hash/owner/client, revoked reviewer, expiry or stale policy: reject before dispatch.
